abstract: BACKGROUND: Teratomas arise from primordial germ cells which arrest during its migration from the hindgut allantois the gonads during the first weeks of gestational life, they may occur in both gonadal and extra-gonadal locations. They occur in 1/40,000 live births. The most common anatomical locations are the sacro-coccygeal region and the ovary, neck teratomas constituted about 1.5%. Malignant transformation has been reported. CASE PRESENTATION: A 2-year-old boy presented with a gradually enlarging mass in the left side of the neck causing stridor and difficulties in respiration especially during sleep, the parents noticed difficulties during swallowing. The mass was misdiagnosed as cystic hygroma and the patient underwent 2 sessions of sclerotherapy with no improvement. Clinical examination showed a large mass in the left side of the neck which was multilobulated causing tracheal shift to the opposite side. There were no signs of inflammations over the mass. CT-scan showed evidence of enhancing multi-cystic lesion with multiple flecks of calcification. Complete surgical resection was done successfully and the histopathological study of the mass showed mature elements of ectodermal, mesodermal, and ectodermal germinal layers which was consistent with mature cystic teratoma. The follow up showed no postoperative complications. CONCLUSION: Mature cystic teratoma of the neck is very rare and may be difficult to be differentiated both clinically and radiologically from other neck masses. The accurate diagnosis must be made before any kind of treatment is started. Complete surgical resection is the main management option and required to decrease the recurrence.
abstract_ja: 背景：奇形腫は、妊娠初期に後腸尿膜から性腺への移動の途中で停止した原始生殖細胞に由来する。出生10万人（1/40,000）に約1例の頻度で発生する。最も一般的な解剖学的部位は仙尾部と卵巣であり、頸部奇形腫は約1.5%を占める。悪性転化も報告されている。症例提示：2歳男児が、左側頸部の徐々に増大する腫瘤を呈した。腫瘤は喘鳴と呼吸困難、特に睡眠中の呼吸困難を引き起こしており、両親は嚥下困難にも気付いていた。腫瘤は嚢胞性リンパ管腫と誤診され、患者は硬化療法を2回受けたが改善はみられなかった。臨床検査では、左側頸部に多房性で分葉状の大きな腫瘤を認め、気管が対側へ偏位していた。腫瘤上に炎症所見はなかった。CT検査では、多数の石灰化斑を伴う増強される多嚢胞性病変を認めた。腫瘤の完全な外科的切除が無事に行われ、病理組織学的検査で外胚葉、中胚葉、内胚葉の成熟成分が認められ、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と一致した。術後の経過観察で合併症はみられなかった。結論：頸部成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は非常にまれであり、臨床的にも放射線学的にも他の頸部腫瘤との鑑別が困難な場合がある。治療を開始する前に、正確な診断を行う必要がある。完全な外科的切除が主要な治療選択肢であり、再発を減らすために必要である。
